nonClaims: This verdict register does not create reviewed artifacts.
This verdict register does not open model admission.
This verdict register does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, intervention ranking, clinical validity claims or individual death-date output.
Fresh-review verdicts only affect bounded artifact-prep eligibility and do not override downstream artifact, model-validation or prohibited-use gates.
Dynamic donor-registration routes, access-restricted routes, duplicate-lineage routes and index/provenance routes remain blocked even when route identity is verified.

newFreshReviewFacts: CDC transplant-safety clinical guidance can enter bounded artifact preparation only as a transplant-safety and donor-derived infection governance source; duplicate-lineage counting with EXT-022 remains controlled.
FDA HCT/P donor eligibility guidance can enter bounded artifact preparation as donor-screening and tissue-product safety governance context, not individual donor eligibility advice.
Donate Life and RegisterMe remain donor-registration route infrastructure/context rows because dynamic access, access restrictions and jurisdictional flow details prevent exact claim admission.

FDA xenotransplantation specific guidance can enter bounded artifact preparation for source-animal, product, preclinical and clinical issue vocabulary with strict engineering/clinical transfer boundaries.
FDA xenotransplantation guidance index remains index/provenance context only and cannot substitute for a specific guidance source.
All rows keep calibrated prediction, clinical validity claims, intervention ranking, individual advice and individual death-date output blocked.
